description: tools/test-projects/tween-curve (WEB_PROJECT=tween-curve tools/build.sh web): a Position Tween with the ease Curve (S27 AC7). Every frame the tween's value is the curve at its time and the box at 10 x it; five sampled times log ok, a mismatch is an error. No pixel check: the box has moved back to the left by the end.

console.text: [gate] tween_curve 5 samples: value = curve(time), x = 10 value
